entries.statement_text: Every connected bipartite distance-regular graph is Hamiltonian.
entries.status_detail: The paper calls this its most intriguing conjecture left open.

entries.statement_text: Every graph which is both planar and vertex transitive is Hamiltonian.
entries.status_detail: The same paper proves this later as Theorem 20.

entries.statement_text: Every graph which is both Eulerian and vertex transitive is Hamiltonian.
entries.status_detail: Listed among conjectures for which the authors found neither proof nor counterexample.

entries.statement_text: Every graph which is vertex transitive and contains an induced C4 is Hamiltonian.
entries.status_detail: Listed among conjectures for which the authors found neither proof nor counterexample.

entries.statement_text: Every graph which is both distance regular and perfect is Hamiltonian.
entries.status_detail: Listed among conjectures for which the authors found neither proof nor counterexample.

entries.statement_text: Every graph which is semi-symmetric is Hamiltonian.
entries.status_detail: Listed among conjectures for which the authors found neither proof nor counterexample.
